AuthorId.description: Who issued a command: the local user in local mode.

BlobRef.description:
A blob's file name under `blobs/`: 64 lower-case hex digits of the
BLAKE3 of its bytes, a dot, and an extension of lower-case letters
and digits (`arrisbody`, `json`).

BodyMeasures.description: A body's measures, in SI, and its topology counts.

BodySlot.description:
A body slot, named by the feature that made it: the name a mesh of its
final version goes by, whatever feature made that version.

Change.description: A change the authority made: one item of the applied stream.

command.description:
What was applied: the submitted command, or the inverse an undo or
redo applied.

Command.description:
One edit of the document. One gesture is one command; a multi-step
gesture is a `Group`.

oneOf.description: A part with its features: the inverse of `DeletePart`.

Inserts `record` at history index `at`. Inserting before the
rollback index moves the index with the features after it.
Moves a feature to history index `to`, counted after the move.

carries the positions its author solved for; applying it never
solves (ADR-0005).
One undo entry.

Constraint.description:
One constraint in the residual system. Dimensional values are SI
(meters / radians) — the UI converts from mm/deg on the way in.

oneOf.description: `a` and `b` share coordinates (2 residuals).

Line is vertical: dx == 0 (1 residual).

Point-to-point vertical alignment: pa.x == pb.x (1 residual).

Two lines are perpendicular: dot(dir_a, dir_b) == 0 (1 residual).

Two circles/arcs share center: center_a == center_b (2 residuals).
Line tangent to circle/arc: distance(center, line) == radius (1 residual).

Distance between two points (1 residual).
Horizontal distance between two points: |pa.x - pb.x| == value (1 residual).
Vertical distance between two points: |pa.y - pb.y| == value (1 residual).
Perpendicular distance from a point to a line (1 residual).
Perpendicular distance between two parallel lines (1 residual).
Angle between two lines, in radians (1 residual).
Circle (or arc) radius in meters (1 residual).

Point lies on the infinite line through a line entity (1 residual).

Soft/hard pin used during drag and for construction anchors that
aren't marked `Point::fixed`. Two residuals.
Central symmetry: `a` and `b` symmetric about `center` (2 residuals: pa + pb - 2*pc == 0).
Perimeter clearance distance between two circles/arcs (1 residual).
Point lies on datum (Origin: (0,0), AxisX: y=0, AxisY: x=0).
Point is coincident to datum (for Origin: 2 residuals (x=0, y=0); for AxisX: y=0; for AxisY: x=0).

ConstraintPriority.description:
Priority in the solve. Primary constraints are enforced; drag
constraints guide the free degrees of freedom during a drag.

ConstraintRecord.description:
A stored constraint: its id, the constraint, and its flags. The fields
at their defaults are not written.

display_pos.description: Where a dimension's label sits, plane-local `(u, v)`.

expr.description:
The expression source that drives a dimension's value
(`"plate_w / 2"`). Opaque here: this crate never parses it; the
document resolves it before every solve. It lives on the record so
undo and removal carry it along.

is_active.description: A suppressed (inactive) constraint is ignored by the solver.

is_driving.description: Driving constraints are solved; a reference one is a measurement.

name.description: A name the user gave it (`Width_Slot_1`).

CurveKey.description:
A curve of a profile: the id of the sketch entity it came from, or
a key a plugin chooses, stable across evaluations for the same
logical curve. Side faces are rooted at it (docs/DATA-MODEL.md
§Persistent naming).

DatumEntity.description: Built-in coordinate datum entity in the sketch's local 2D UV coordinate system.

oneOf.description: Origin point at (0, 0).
Horizontal axis along Y = 0 (U axis, direction (1, 0)).
Vertical axis along X = 0 (V axis, direction (0, 1)).

Diagnostic.description:
A failure, warning or note the user sees, on a feature, in the status
bar and in `arrix eval`'s output.

candidates.description:
For a lost reference, what the user might re-pick, best first
(docs/DATA-MODEL.md §Persistent naming, "Resolution"). Never
applied by the core: re-picking is the user's command.

refs.description: What to highlight: the entities the failure is about.

DiagnosticCode.description:
A stable, countable key: `segment(.segment)*`, each segment lower-kebab
(`ref.lost`, `kernel.degenerate.tangent-contact`). Checked when built,
so one that crosses a boundary is always well-formed.

DocHash.description:
BLAKE3 over a document's saved files, as 64 hex digits: equal
documents, equal hashes.

Entity.description:
A curve built on points. Lines and arcs own their ends as [`PointId`]s,
so a shared vertex is coincident by identity, not only by constraint. A
circle's radius is a solver variable of its own.

oneOf.description: A lone point, drawn as geometry of its own.

radius.description: In metres; a solver variable unless constrained.

oneOf.description:
A circular arc counter-clockwise from `start` to `end` about
`center`. `|start − center|` and `|end − center|` are held equal by
an implicit residual.

EvalEvent.description: One feature's outcome, as the evaluator publishes it.

ExportFormat.description: A file format a part is exported as.

oneOf.description: STEP AP214 Part 21 text, the exact B-rep.
Binary STL of the refined meshes.
OBJ text of the refined meshes.

Expr.description: An expression: its text as typed, and the tree parsed from it.

FeatureEdit.description:
What an `EditFeature` changes; a field it leaves out is kept. In
`params`, `choices` and `inputs`, `null` removes the entry.

FeatureId.description: A feature record in a part's history.

cached.description: Reused from the cache: nothing it reads changed.

diagnostics.description:
What is worth knowing and did not stop it: why it is frozen,
and that it reads a stale stored result.

frozen.description:
Set when the outputs are a stored result (docs/DATA-MODEL.md
§Frozen results).

oneOf.description: No outputs; the feature keeps its parameters and says why.

call.description:
The kernel call it failed at, kept for a fixture.
The kernel's own record, which the protocol does not describe.

call_index.description:
That call's place in the kernel's records, which a recipe
needs to find the calls that made its operands.

oneOf.description: At or after its part's rollback index.

FeatureRecord.description: One history entry. Built-in and plugin features have this one shape.

choices.description:
The form's plain values: a word from a list the feature type
names, such as a datum plane's world plane (`xy`).

frozen.description:
A plugin feature's last result (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §Frozen
results); omitted when there is none. Boxed, as `sketch` is.

inputs.description:
Named inputs: a plane, a profile, faces, a body; a list of
references for an input that takes several (ADR-0012).

name.description: What the tree shows; unique within the part.

params.description: The form's numeric fields, each an expression.

sketch.description:
A `core.sketch` feature's sketch: its entities, constraints with
their dimensions' expressions, and last solved positions
(docs/DATA-MODEL.md §Sketches). Changed only by `SketchEdit`.
Boxed: most features hold none, and a command carries records.

type_version.description: The feature type's own schema version.

FeatureTypeId.description:
`core.<name>` for a built-in, `<plugin>.<name>` for a plugin's; the
name is lower-kebab words.

Frame.description:
A right-handed frame: an origin and unit X and Z axes, Y = Z × X. A
plane is the frame's XY plane, its normal Z.

FrozenInfo.description:
A frozen feature's state: stale when its inputs now differ from the
ones its stored result was made from.

FrozenReason.description: Why a plugin feature evaluates from its stored result.

oneOf.description: The registry has no such feature type.

The type's version, or its plugin's, is outside what the stored
result was made under.

FrozenResult.description:
What a plugin feature last evaluated to, kept so the document opens
without the plugin.

input_hash.description: The feature's input hash when the result was stored.

names.description: The persistent-name table of every stored entity.

slots.description: One blob of Arris body bytes per body slot.

Generation.description: Bumped by every applied command, undo and redo included.

Input.description:
What a feature record holds under one input name: one `Ref`, or a list
of them for an input that takes several (ADR-0012). Serialised
untagged, a `Ref` object or an array of them, so a record written
before lists existed reads unchanged. The order of a list is kept.

MeshDetail.description:
How fine a mesh is asked for: a coarse one first so a body shows at
once, then a refined one (docs/CONCURRENCY-WASM.md §Tessellation).

MeshPoint.description: A body's vertex, by name, at its place relative to the mesh's origin.

MeshRange.description:
A run of a mesh's triangles (a face), edge points (an edge) and the
entity it draws, by name.

Node.description: A node of the DAG: what a command touches and the evaluator orders.

history.description: The order the user sees and edits.

rollback.description: Features at and after this index are not evaluated.

PersistentName.description: A face, edge or vertex: a root and what happened to it since.

PluginId.description: `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`, and never `core`, which the built-ins own.

Point.description: A 2D point in plane-local coordinates, in metres.

fixed.description:
A fixed point is not a solver variable: it anchors the sketch in
the plane.

PreviewBody.description:
A final body of a preview: `changed` when its version is not the one
the generation it was taken on ends with, so a `PreviewMeshed` follows.
A body of the generation missing from the list is one the preview
consumes.

PreviewId.description: A client's name for one of its previews, counted by the client.

PreviewTag.description: Whose preview an event is of, and which.

Profile.description:
A planar region to sweep: an outer loop and holes, in the (u, v)
coordinates of `plane`, every curve keyed. Whether the loops close,
nest and avoid each other is the kernel's to check; this type checks
only what naming needs: numbers finite, radii positive, keys unique.

ProfileLoop.description:
One closed loop: a full circle, or a chain of segments from `start`
that returns there.

ProfileSegment.description:
A segment of a path, from where the previous one ended. Its key names
the side face it sweeps, and the vertex it starts at names the edges
and vertices there.

oneOf.description: A circular arc through `via` to `to`.

Quantity.description: A value of a kind, in SI.

QuantityKind.description: What a number measures. Count and ratio are dimensionless.

RecordId.description: A plugin's record in its own section.

Ref.description:
A reference from one record to another. `Topo` is the one naming
solves; the rest are by id.

oneOf.description: A body, datum or sketch output of a feature.
A face, edge or vertex.
A point or curve of a sketch.
A region of a sketch: a face of its planar arrangement, by its key.
A plugin's document record.

RegionKey.description:
Which face of a sketch's planar arrangement a feature was given
(docs/DATA-MODEL.md §Sketches): every entity bounding the face, its
holes' included, sorted, plus a point inside it. The entity set alone
does not name a face (a circle and its chord bound the cap and the D
alike), so the sample tells two faces of the same curves apart.
`arrix-sketch` resolves a key to exactly one region or to none.

The sample is in whole nanometres of the sketch's `(u, v)`, so a key
is plain data that compares, orders and hashes exactly, as every `Ref`
does. A nanometre is a thousandth of the length tolerance, and the
sample sits as far inside its face as the face allows.

entities.description:
Sorted and deduplicated, so two keys of one face compare equal
whichever order their loops were walked in.

sample.description: A point inside the face, in nanometres.

RegionView.description:
One region: the key a feature stores to come back to it, and the
region as a profile on the sketch's plane, its curves keyed by entity
(docs/DATA-MODEL.md §Persistent naming).

RenderMesh.description:
One body's mesh. Positions are `f32` metres relative to `origin`, the
centre of the body's box, so the cast from the kernel's `f64` loses
nothing a screen shows wherever the body stands. A vertex of the
triangle buffer belongs to one face: the faces meet along equal
positions, never shared vertices, so each carries its own face's
outward normal and a sharp edge stays sharp.

chord.description: The chord it was made at, metres.

edge_points.description: The edges' polylines, one run each, end to end along the edge.

faces.description: Each face's run of `triangles`; together they cover them, in order.

triangles.description: Indices into `positions`, anticlockwise seen from outside.

Sketch.description:
A 2D sketch on a plane, in plane-local metres. The hosting `core.sketch`
feature maps the plane into space.

Every reference inside resolves: an entity's points and a constraint's
points and entities are in the sketch, construction marks name entities
it holds, and one id names one record across all three maps. The
inserts and a deserialised sketch are checked; removal sweeps what
referenced the removed record.

construction.description:
Construction geometry: solved, constrained and snapped to like any
other entity, but never part of a profile. A set beside `entities`,
swept by every entity removal.

sources.description:
Projected geometry: an entity that is an edge or vertex of a body
projected onto the plane, by that edge's or vertex's name. It is
re-projected on every evaluation, so its stored positions are
recipe, and a lost source fails like any lost reference. Swept by
the entity's removal.

SketchEdit.description:
What a sketch edit changes; an id it leaves out is kept. In `points`,
`entities` and `constraints` an entry puts the record under its id, or
with `null` removes it; in `construction` it sets or clears the mark; in
`sources` it gives the entity its projection source, or with `null`
takes it away.

SketchEntityId.description: A point, curve or constraint in a sketch.

SketchView.description:
A solved sketch, as its `core.sketch` feature outputs it: the plane it
stands on, how free it still is, the solved sketch and its regions.

dof.description: Degrees of freedom left; 0 is fully constrained.

redundant.description:
Constraints the others already imply. Consistent, so the sketch
solves; a client shows them.

sketch.description: Solved from the stored positions with the dimensions resolved.

SlotName.description:
A feature's named output: `body`, `plane`, `sketch`. One lower-kebab
segment, as a diagnostic code's segments are.

SlotView.description: An output slot as a client sees it: plain data, no kernel handle.

event.description: What a subscriber hears, in the order the authority made it.

oneOf.description:
The first event of every subscription: the document at
`generation`, as its directory form's files: the JSON ones as text,
and the frozen results' blobs (`blobs/<name>`) as bytes.

A change the authority applied, with the document's hash after it
in a debug build, for the replicas to check theirs against.
One feature's outcome in the evaluation of `generation`.

The evaluation of `generation` finished, with every parameter's
value. An evaluation a newer generation stopped has no `Finished`.

A final body of `generation`'s evaluation, meshed (docs/
CONCURRENCY-WASM.md §Tessellation): every body coarse first, then
every body refined. A mesh of a superseded generation is never
drawn, and a body that could not be meshed says why. Not part of
the document: a replica ignores it.

A preview's evaluation (ADR-0019): the document at `generation` with
the preview's command applied. Every feature's outcome, every
parameter's value, and the final bodies, each saying whether it
differs from `generation`'s own; a `PreviewMeshed` follows for each
that does. Not part of the document: a replica ignores it.

The file a `Request::Export` asked for, written from the bodies of
`generation`'s evaluation, or why it could not be. Not part of the
document: a replica ignores it.

A body a preview changed, meshed: every one coarse first, then every
one refined, as `Meshed` does for a generation.

Inserts `record` at history index `at`. Inserting before the
rollback index moves the index with the features after it.
Moves a feature to history index `to`, counted after the move.

Puts or removes records of a `core.sketch` feature's sketch. It
carries the positions its author solved for; applying it never
solves (ADR-0005).
One undo entry.

CommandEnvelope.description: A command, its author and the generation the author saw.

Constraint.description:
One constraint in the residual system. Dimensional values are SI
(meters / radians) — the UI converts from mm/deg on the way in.

oneOf.description: `a` and `b` share coordinates (2 residuals).
Line is horizontal: dy == 0 (1 residual).
Line is vertical: dx == 0 (1 residual).
Point-to-point horizontal alignment: pa.y == pb.y (1 residual).
Point-to-point vertical alignment: pa.x == pb.x (1 residual).
Two lines are parallel: cross(dir_a, dir_b) == 0 (1 residual).
Two lines are perpendicular: dot(dir_a, dir_b) == 0 (1 residual).
Equal length between two lines, or equal radius between two circles/arcs (1 residual).
Two circles/arcs share center: center_a == center_b (2 residuals).
Line tangent to circle/arc: distance(center, line) == radius (1 residual).
Two circles/arcs are tangent: dist(c_a, c_b) == r_a + r_b or |r_a - r_b| (1 residual).
`a` and `b` are mirror images across `mirror` (a line entity) (2 residuals).
Distance between two points (1 residual).
Horizontal distance between two points: |pa.x - pb.x| == value (1 residual).
Vertical distance between two points: |pa.y - pb.y| == value (1 residual).
Perpendicular distance from a point to a line (1 residual).
Perpendicular distance between two parallel lines (1 residual).
Angle between two lines, in radians (1 residual).
Circle (or arc) radius in meters (1 residual).
Circle (or arc) diameter in meters: 2 * radius == value (1 residual).
Point lies on the infinite line through a line entity (1 residual).
Point lies on a circle/arc: distance(center, point) == radius (1 residual).
Point is the midpoint of a line (2 residuals).

Soft/hard pin used during drag and for construction anchors that
aren't marked `Point::fixed`. Two residuals.
Central symmetry: `a` and `b` symmetric about `center` (2 residuals: pa + pb - 2*pc == 0).
Perimeter clearance distance between two circles/arcs (1 residual).
Point lies on datum (Origin: (0,0), AxisX: y=0, AxisY: x=0).
Point is coincident to datum (for Origin: 2 residuals (x=0, y=0); for AxisX: y=0; for AxisY: x=0).

ConstraintPriority.description:
Priority in the solve. Primary constraints are enforced; drag
constraints guide the free degrees of freedom during a drag.

ConstraintRecord.description:
A stored constraint: its id, the constraint, and its flags. The fields
at their defaults are not written.

display_pos.description: Where a dimension's label sits, plane-local `(u, v)`.

expr.description:
The expression source that drives a dimension's value
(`"plate_w / 2"`). Opaque here: this crate never parses it; the
document resolves it before every solve. It lives on the record so
undo and removal carry it along.

is_active.description: A suppressed (inactive) constraint is ignored by the solver.

is_driving.description: Driving constraints are solved; a reference one is a measurement.

name.description: A name the user gave it (`Width_Slot_1`).

DatumEntity.description: Built-in coordinate datum entity in the sketch's local 2D UV coordinate system.

oneOf.description: Origin point at (0, 0).
Horizontal axis along Y = 0 (U axis, direction (1, 0)).
Vertical axis along X = 0 (V axis, direction (0, 1)).

Entity.description:
A curve built on points. Lines and arcs own their ends as [`PointId`]s,
so a shared vertex is coincident by identity, not only by constraint. A
circle's radius is a solver variable of its own.

oneOf.description: A lone point, drawn as geometry of its own.

radius.description: In metres; a solver variable unless constrained.

oneOf.description:
A circular arc counter-clockwise from `start` to `end` about
`center`. `|start − center|` and `|end − center|` are held equal by
an implicit residual.

ExportFormat.description: A file format a part is exported as.

oneOf.description: STEP AP214 Part 21 text, the exact B-rep.
Binary STL of the refined meshes.
OBJ text of the refined meshes.

Expr.description: An expression: its text as typed, and the tree parsed from it.

FeatureEdit.description:
What an `EditFeature` changes; a field it leaves out is kept. In
`params`, `choices` and `inputs`, `null` removes the entry.

FeatureId.description: A feature record in a part's history.

FeatureRecord.description: One history entry. Built-in and plugin features have this one shape.

choices.description:
The form's plain values: a word from a list the feature type
names, such as a datum plane's world plane (`xy`).

frozen.description:
A plugin feature's last result (docs/DATA-MODEL.md §Frozen
results); omitted when there is none. Boxed, as `sketch` is.

inputs.description:
Named inputs: a plane, a profile, faces, a body; a list of
references for an input that takes several (ADR-0012).

name.description: What the tree shows; unique within the part.

params.description: The form's numeric fields, each an expression.

sketch.description:
A `core.sketch` feature's sketch: its entities, constraints with
their dimensions' expressions, and last solved positions
(docs/DATA-MODEL.md §Sketches). Changed only by `SketchEdit`.
Boxed: most features hold none, and a command carries records.

type_version.description: The feature type's own schema version.

FeatureTypeId.description:
`core.<name>` for a built-in, `<plugin>.<name>` for a plugin's; the
name is lower-kebab words.

FrozenResult.description:
What a plugin feature last evaluated to, kept so the document opens
without the plugin.

input_hash.description: The feature's input hash when the result was stored.

names.description: The persistent-name table of every stored entity.

slots.description: One blob of Arris body bytes per body slot.

Generation.description: Bumped by every applied command, undo and redo included.

Input.description:
What a feature record holds under one input name: one `Ref`, or a list
of them for an input that takes several (ADR-0012). Serialised
untagged, a `Ref` object or an array of them, so a record written
before lists existed reads unchanged. The order of a list is kept.

history.description: The order the user sees and edits.

rollback.description: Features at and after this index are not evaluated.

PersistentName.description: A face, edge or vertex: a root and what happened to it since.

PluginId.description: `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`, and never `core`, which the built-ins own.

Point.description: A 2D point in plane-local coordinates, in metres.

fixed.description:
A fixed point is not a solver variable: it anchors the sketch in
the plane.

PreviewId.description: A client's name for one of its previews, counted by the client.

QuantityKind.description: What a number measures. Count and ratio are dimensionless.

RecordId.description: A plugin's record in its own section.

Ref.description:
A reference from one record to another. `Topo` is the one naming
solves; the rest are by id.

oneOf.description: A body, datum or sketch output of a feature.
A face, edge or vertex.
A point or curve of a sketch.
A region of a sketch: a face of its planar arrangement, by its key.
A plugin's document record.

RegionKey.description:
Which face of a sketch's planar arrangement a feature was given
(docs/DATA-MODEL.md §Sketches): every entity bounding the face, its
holes' included, sorted, plus a point inside it. The entity set alone
does not name a face (a circle and its chord bound the cap and the D
alike), so the sample tells two faces of the same curves apart.
`arrix-sketch` resolves a key to exactly one region or to none.

The sample is in whole nanometres of the sketch's `(u, v)`, so a key
is plain data that compares, orders and hashes exactly, as every `Ref`
does. A nanometre is a thousandth of the length tolerance, and the
sample sits as far inside its face as the face allows.

entities.description:
Sorted and deduplicated, so two keys of one face compare equal
whichever order their loops were walked in.

sample.description: A point inside the face, in nanometres.

Sketch.description:
A 2D sketch on a plane, in plane-local metres. The hosting `core.sketch`
feature maps the plane into space.

Every reference inside resolves: an entity's points and a constraint's
points and entities are in the sketch, construction marks name entities
it holds, and one id names one record across all three maps. The
inserts and a deserialised sketch are checked; removal sweeps what
referenced the removed record.

SketchEdit.description:
What a sketch edit changes; an id it leaves out is kept. In `points`,
`entities` and `constraints` an entry puts the record under its id, or
with `null` removes it; in `construction` it sets or clears the mark; in
`sources` it gives the entity its projection source, or with `null`
takes it away.

SketchEntityId.description: A point, curve or constraint in a sketch.

SlotName.description:
A feature's named output: `body`, `plane`, `sketch`. One lower-kebab
segment, as a diagnostic code's segments are.

request.description: What a client asks of the authority.

oneOf.description:
Evaluates the document with the envelope's command applied, never
applying it (ADR-0019): refused or stale as its submit would be, and
otherwise answered `Previewing`, its events following. It supersedes
the session's previous preview, whoever took it.
Drops `author`'s preview, if it is the session's: its events stop.

Writes the final bodies `bodies` names (every one when empty) as
`format`, once the newest commit is evaluated; answered `Exporting`,
the file following as `Exported`. Not a command: the document does
not change, no generation is made and nothing is undone.
